description: This Java class 'ThingsService' serves as the entry point for the Eclipse Ditto 'Things' service. It sets up configuration, initializes the actor system, and connects routes for handling 'Things' related operations within the Ditto framework.

classes.name: ThingsService
classes.description: Main service class for 'Things' in Eclipse Ditto, extends DittoService, handles configuration and initialization of actor system.

methods.name: ThingsService
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the service with logger, service name, and actor name.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Static method to start the ThingsService, waits for termination.

methods.description: Overrides to parse specific configuration for the 'Things' service.
